faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur is 17th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MTech/MS/ME or BE/BTech in Electrical/Electronics/Aerospace Engineering with a specialization in signal processing. A minimum of 65% marks throughout their academic career since class 10, or 7/10 CGPA afterwards, along with a valid GATE/NET score, is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. However, age relaxation may be applicable based on sponsor agency rules, if any, as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment at IIT Kharagpur. Both General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Junior Research Fellow recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/FNI/2026/105.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Kharagpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal, with the pincode 721302.
